extracted.intended_audience: aspiring and working screenwriters, TV writers, and pitch writers submitting to Script Pipeline contests or development programs
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and entry criteria for submitting feature screenplays, television pilots, pitches, and higher-concept film/TV material to Script Pipeline contests, workshops, and development programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Screenwriting Contest — feature screenplays across all genres
rubrics_metrics.description: "The 24th Annual Script Pipeline Screenwriting Contest is searching for extraordinary writers with feature screenplays across all genres."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Open to feature screenplays in any genre; emphasis on "extraordinary" writing. (Page lists Late Deadline: May 15, 2026; annual contest; submit / details links available.)

rubrics_metrics.name: TV Writing Contest — original television pilots or unproduced indie series scripts
rubrics_metrics.description: "The 19th Annual Script Pipeline TV Writing Contest is searching for extraordinary writers with original television pilots or unproduced indie series scripts."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entrants should submit original television pilots or unproduced series scripts; emphasis on originality and unproduced status. (Page lists Late Deadline: May 15, 2026; annual contest; submit / details links available.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Pitch Contest — original feature film and TV series ideas
rubrics_metrics.description: "The bi-annual 2026 Script Pipeline Pitch Contest is searching for original feature film and TV series ideas to be developed into screenplays and pilots."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions should be original ideas (pitches) for feature films or TV series with potential for development into scripts or pilots. (Page lists Regular Deadline: June 15, 2026; bi‑annual contest.)

rubrics_metrics.name: First Look Project — higher-concept material across multiple categories
rubrics_metrics.description: "The 14th Annual First Look Project searches for higher-concept material across MULTIPLE categories for film and TV, introducing select writers to reps and producers."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus on "higher-concept" material (high-concept, marketable ideas) across various film/TV categories; selection includes introductions to representatives and producers. (Page lists Early Deadline: June 25, 2026.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Originality and unproduced status as entry criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Across contest descriptions the site repeatedly seeks "original" work (original television pilots, original feature film and TV series ideas) and references unproduced scripts ("unproduced indie series scripts").
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entrants are expected to submit original, previously unproduced material appropriate to the contest format (feature script, pilot, pitch). The site emphasizes novelty/originality as a selection factor.

rubrics_metrics.name: Workshop (Review and Development) — developmental notes with industry focus
rubrics_metrics.description: "As one of the longest-running notes services, the Script Pipeline Workshop is rooted in three goals: help writers improve their craft, connect them with representation, and push more scripts to production."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Workshop feedback is framed as craft-improving, representation-focused, and production-oriented — reviews/notes should aim to ready scripts for industry opportunities and connections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Symposium — career-building events led by working professionals
rubrics_metrics.description: "A year-round conference in the arts comprised of unique, career-building virtual events, led by working professionals in screenwriting, filmmaking, and publishing."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Educational sessions emphasize career development and are taught/led by current industry practitioners; useful for writers seeking practical, industry-relevant guidance rather than purely academic instruction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pipeline Artists — platform to educate and spotlight under-the-radar creators
rubrics_metrics.description: "A platform dedicated to educating creatives, spotlighting under-the-radar writers and filmmakers, publishing short fiction, hosting original podcasts, and providing a resource unlike any other digital magazine in the arts."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritizes showcasing emerging/under-the-radar talent and educational content (short fiction, podcasts). Implies value placed on distinct voices and discoverability in addition to craft.
